g.text: Exact counts are reported in Supplementary Table S4
C | Genuine failure is defined only among eligible decisions
Each codec contributes 254 development decisions per threshold. Protocol A.1 removes invalid successes as well as invalid failures; non-evaluable is neither pass nor failure.
At 10^-4 and 10^-3 e, more than 93% of naive failures for every codec lie on non-evaluable material-threshold pairs.
